summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that, when `bun` is not on PATH, downloads a Bun runtime release zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727,680-byte payload with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` banner and heavy obfuscation: a rotating string-array (`WV8StW`), a mixed hex/int/token mega-array (`n7gIxM`), and a runtime decoder (`hc1jfK9`) — no readable declarations. The package advertises itself as `@ornikar/repo-config-react` with a repository URL pointing at the public Ornikar shared-configs GitHub organization, but neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` exist in that upstream repository, and the tarball declares no `files` allowlist. The filename `math_init.js` is unrelated to the package's declared purpose (a React repo-config helper), and executing an obfuscated multi-hundred-KB blob through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time hands attacker-controlled code execution to the installer's host regardless of what that payload does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
